name: dopp
description: A drop-in proxy for Jev-compatible decision APIs that keeps every request and trains small open models on them.

scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local -c worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run db:migrate && wrangler dev -c worker/wrangler.toml --port ${PORT:-8787}
scripts.deploy:db: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote -c worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy -c worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.example:gatekeeper: npm run build && npm install --prefix examples/gatekeeper --no-audit --no-fund --silent && node examples/gatekeeper/run.mjs
